svg.title: Pangrova architecture overview
svg.desc: Layered architecture: clients, streaming ingestion, and AI applications connect over HTTP to a Java Coordinator that parses, plans, authorizes, admits, and schedules work. Durable control state lives in PostgreSQL with optional ZooKeeper. Workers execute through JNI in C++/Velox, exchange data over Arrow Flight, and read and write Iceberg, Paimon, and Lance tables through the Connector SPI. Security, governance, observability, and cache are cross-cutting services.
